**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/29 (Sun) 17:19
- [USER] User inquired about the acceptance rate for the nursing program at the University of Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The University of Michigan's School of Nursing reported an acceptance rate of 16.5% for their Bachelor of Science in Nursing program for the 2019-2020 academic year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Acceptance rates can vary from year to year and may differ for different degree programs within the nursing school.
- [USER] User asked for the average GPA and SAT score for students accepted into the nursing program at the University of Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The middle 50% range for admitted students' high school GPA is typically between 3.8 and 4.0 on a 4.0 scale.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The middle 50% range for SAT scores is typically between 1380 and 1540 with the essay component, and between 1320 and 1500 without the essay component.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Admission decisions are based on a range of factors beyond just GPA and test scores, such as extracurricular activities, essays, and letters of recommendation.
- [USER] User requested more details about the specific coursework and clinical experiences offered in the nursing program at the University of Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The nursing program combines classroom instruction with hands-on clinical experience.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Core Nursing Curriculum includes courses in human biology, pathophysiology, genetics, pharmacology, therapeutic interventions, nursing research, health care systems, and leadership.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Students are placed in a variety of clinical settings, including hospitals, clinics, and community health centers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Students gain experience in a range of nursing specialties and work with patients of all ages.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The School of Nursing has several simulation labs for practicing clinical skills in a safe environment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Students collaborate with peers from other health professions for interprofessional education.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The International Nursing Immersion Program offers clinical experiences in countries such as Ghana, India, and the Dominican Republic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Research opportunities are available for nursing students to work with faculty on various projects.
- [USER] User asked about the faculty members who teach in the nursing program at the University of Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Faculty members are highly experienced and accomplished professionals in the nursing field.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many faculty members hold advanced degrees or certifications in nursing specialties.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Faculty are involved in research
